impl Display for Token {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter) -> std::fmt::Result {
        match self {
            Self::Number(s) => write!(f, "NUMBER({s})"),
            Self::String(s) => write!(f, "STRING({s})"),
            Self::Ident(s) => write!(f, "IDENT({s})"),
            Self::Keyword(k) => write!(f, "KEYWORD({k})"),
            Self::Period => write!(f, "PERIOD"),
            Self::Equal => write!(f, "EQUAL"),
            Self::NotEqual => write!(f, "NOTEQUAL"),
            Self::GreaterThan => write!(f, "GREATER"),
            Self::GreaterThanOrEqual => write!(f, "GREATEREQUAL"),
            Self::LessThan => write!(f, "LESS"),
            Self::LessThanOrEqual => write!(f, "LESSEQUAL"),
            Self::LessOrGreaterThan => write!(f, "LESSTHANGREATER"),
            Self::Plus => write!(f, "PLUS"),
            Self::Minus => write!(f, "MINUS"),
            Self::Asterisk => write!(f, "ASTERISK"),
            Self::Slash => write!(f, "SLASH"),
            Self::Caret => write!(f, "CARET"),
            Self::Percent => write!(f, "PERCENT"),
            Self::Exclamation => write!(f, "EXCLAMATION"),
            Self::Question => write!(f, "QUESTION"),
            Self::Comma => write!(f, "COMMA"),
            Self::Semicolon => write!(f, "SEMICOLON"),
            Self::OpenParen => write!(f, "OPENPAREN"),
            Self::CloseParen => write!(f, "CLOSEPAREN"),
        }
    }
}

impl From<Keyword> for Token {
    fn from(keyword: Keyword) -> Self {
        Token::Keyword(keyword)
    }
}
